# Luis Reche

> Applied AI Engineer in Palma, Spain. I turn LLMs and coding agents into software people use. I use AI to accelerate the work and keep a human in the loop.

## Experience

- Applied AI Engineer at Agentero, Apr 2026 to present. Infrastructure on Google Cloud, backend services in Go, and the marketplace interface in Next.js.
- Freelance software engineer for SocialPro, 2025 to present. The agency website, a brand portal and the first internal CRM, and the Piroboom website for one of their clients.
- Freelance product engineer at RecheDev, 2021 to present. ClipHub, and Berrus, a browser role-playing game.

## Projects

- [ClipHub](https://cliphub.gravityroom.app/): Windows desktop app that turns a CS2 demo into an edited video of the best plays.
- [SocialPro](https://socialpro.es): website of a gaming and esports creator agency, with a brand portal and the first internal CRM.
- [Piroboom](https://pirotecniaelche.es): website of a fireworks shop in Elche, live in production, with a searchable catalogue reader and enquiry forms.
- [Gravity Room](https://gravityroom.app): live strength tracker with automatic progression, on web and mobile.
- [Honey Encryption Proxy](https://github.com/rechedev9/honey-encryption-proxy): local proxy in front of Claude Code that swaps proprietary names for stand-ins before a request leaves the machine.
- [riskforge](https://github.com/rechedev9/riskforge): insurance quote gateway in Go with Terraform for Cloud Run, Spanner and Pub/Sub. A portfolio project.

## Stack

- AI and agents: Claude Code, Codex, MCP servers, Skills and plugins, Multi-agent workflows, Human approval gates
- Backend: Go, Bun, Elysia, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, SQLite
- Web: TypeScript, React, Next.js, TanStack, Astro, Tailwind CSS
- Mobile and desktop: Expo, React Native, Electron, Rust core with UniFFI
- Infrastructure: Docker, GCP, Terraform, Vercel, GitHub Actions
